commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
SERIAL="$(PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -m aicall_tools.device.s22_adb_discovery --serial RFCT70L7E8J)"
export QA_USB_SERIAL="$SERIAL"
python3 - <<'PY'
import os, re, subprocess, time, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
serial=os.environ["QA_USB_SERIAL"]
pkg="pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge"
uri="content://"+pkg+".gsmbinder"
def adb(*args):
    p=subprocess.run(["adb","-s",serial,*args],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=25)
    if p.returncode: raise RuntimeError("ADB_OPERATION_FAILED")
    return p.stdout
def safe():
    states=re.findall(r"mCallState=(\d+)",adb("shell","dumpsys","telephony.registry"))
    if not states or any(x!="0" for x in states): raise RuntimeError("PHONE_NOT_IDLE")
    if "Actual mode = MODE_NORMAL" not in adb("shell","dumpsys","audio"): raise RuntimeError("AUDIO_NOT_IDLE")
    if adb("shell","cmd","role","get-role-holders","--user","0","android.app.role.DIALER").strip()!=pkg: raise RuntimeError("DIALER_CHANGED")
    if "host_registered=true" not in adb("shell","content","call","--uri",uri,"--method","status"): raise RuntimeError("GSM_HOST_UNAVAILABLE")
def armed():
    result=adb("shell","content","call","--uri",uri,"--method","qa_status")
    if "armed=true" in result: return True
    if "armed=false" in result: return False
    raise RuntimeError("QA_STATUS_UNKNOWN")
def ui():
    path="/data/local/tmp/aicalls-qa-ui.xml"
    try:
        adb("shell","uiautomator","dump",path)
        return ET.fromstring(adb("exec-out","cat",path))
    finally:
        adb("shell","rm","-f",path)
def click(labels):
    root=ui()
    candidates=[]
    for n in root.iter("node"):
        if n.get("package") not in {pkg,"android"}: continue
        if n.get("enabled")!="true": continue
        if not ({n.get("text",""),n.get("content-desc","")} & set(labels)): continue
        coords=list(map(int,re.findall(r"\d+",n.get("bounds",""))))
        if len(coords)==4 and coords[2]>coords[0] and coords[3]>coords[1]:
            candidates.append(((coords[0]+coords[2])//2,(coords[1]+coords[3])//2))
    candidates=list(dict.fromkeys(candidates))
    if len(candidates)!=1: return False
    safe()
    adb("shell","input","tap",*map(str,candidates[0]))
    time.sleep(0.7)
    return True
try:
    safe()
    if not armed():
        print("STAGE=OPEN_EXISTING_TEST_LAB",flush=True)
        qa=("QA rozmowy GSM","Live call QA")
        consent=("Włącz nadzór","Enable supervision")
        if not click(qa):
            adb("shell","am","start","-W","-n",pkg+"/.MainActivity")
            time.sleep(1)
            if not click(("Ustawienia","Settings")):
                raise RuntimeError("SETTINGS_BUTTON_NOT_FOUND")
            if not click(("Laboratorium offline","Offline laboratory")):
                if not click(("Narzędzia programistyczne","Developer tools")) or not click(("Laboratorium offline","Offline laboratory")):
                    raise RuntimeError("TEST_LAB_BUTTON_NOT_FOUND")
            if not click(qa): raise RuntimeError("LIVE_QA_BUTTON_NOT_FOUND")
        print("STAGE=OWNER_AUTHORIZED_ENABLE",flush=True)
        if not click(consent): raise RuntimeError("QA_ENABLE_BUTTON_NOT_FOUND")
        for _ in range(5):
            if armed(): break
            time.sleep(0.5)
    if not armed(): raise RuntimeError("QA_ENABLE_NOT_CONFIRMED")
    safe()
    print("QA_ARMED=true")
    print("MAIN_GSM_HOST_READY=true")
    print("NO_CALLS=true")
except Exception as e:
    print("HOLD="+str(e) if isinstance(e,RuntimeError) else "HOLD=UI_OR_ADB_ERROR")
    raise SystemExit(1)
PY
# One-time local encryption key for staging the user's number and goal without plaintext in Git.
umask 077
KEYDIR="$HOME/.local/share/aicalls-qa/one-time-stage"
mkdir -p "$KEYDIR"
chmod 700 "$KEYDIR"
KEY="$KEYDIR/stage-20261126-v1.pem"
test ! -e "$KEY"
openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:3072 -out "$KEY" 2>/dev/null
chmod 600 "$KEY"
echo STAGE_PUBLIC_KEY_BEGIN
openssl pkey -in "$KEY" -pubout
echo STAGE_PUBLIC_KEY_END
echo PRIVATE_STAGE_KEY_READY=true
